Based on Kentucky Revised Statutes § 431.220, lethal injection is the default and standard method of execution for all death sentences in Kentucky. The electric chair is not the default; rather, it is retained solely as an alternative method for inmates who received a death sentence prior to March 31, 1998, and who explicitly elect to be executed by electrocution.
